response.sql: WITH filtered_processing AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, sp.memusagegb, sp.procgpu, sp.proccpu FROM scanprocessing sp WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 AND sp.zoneref IS NOT NULL), matched_sites AS (SELECT fp.zoneref, fp.memusagegb, fp.procgpu, fp.proccpu, s.entrystat FROM filtered_processing fp INNER JOIN sites s ON fp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), per_site_stats AS (SELECT ms.zoneref, ms.entrystat, AVG(ms.memusagegb) as avg_ram_per_site, AVG(CASE WHEN ms.procgpu IS NOT NULL AND ms.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND ms.proccpu != 0 THEN CAST(ms.procgpu AS FLOAT) / CAST(ms.proccpu AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio_per_site FROM matched_sites ms GROUP BY ms.zoneref, ms.entrystat) SELECT pss.entrystat, AVG(pss.avg_ram_per_site) as avg_ram_usage, AVG(pss.avg_gpu_cpu_ratio_per_site) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site_stats pss GROUP BY pss.entrystat ORDER BY pss.entrystat
